test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: On April 21, 2023, which state assembly passed a bill amending the Factories Act 1948, for flexible working hours and extending factory workers 'working hours from 8 to 12 hours?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu Assembly.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu Assembly** passed a bill amending the** Factories Act 1948 on April 21, 2023,** for flexible working hours and extending factory workers' working hours from 8 to 12 hours.
 
• The amendment was made to **increase the productivity and competitiveness** of the manufacturing sector in the state and to provide more employment opportunities for workers.
 
• The bill also includes provisions for **adequate rest intervals, overtime pay**, and safety measures for workers who work for **extended hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Factories Act of 1948** is an Indian law that regulates the working conditions in factories, including** the safety, health, welfare, **and working hours of workers.
 
• The amendment made by the **Tamil Nadu Assembly **is a controversial one, as it has been **criticized by labor unions and workers' rights **groups for compromising the safety and health of workers and violating their rights.
 
• The Bihar Assembly is the legislative body of the state of Bihar, Punjab Assembly is the legislative body of the state of Punjab, and Kerala Assembly is the legislative body of the state of Kerala.
